style: Photorealistic Indian interior product reference photography, complete unit visible, natural lighting, no text or watermark.

subjects.kitchen-base: L-shaped glossy teal handleless kitchen base cabinets with black granite countertop
subjects.wall-glass: Compact kitchen WALL BOX with two framed clear GLASS SHUTTERS, visible internal glass shelves and warm concealed light, mounted above a worktop. This is a small upper wall cabinet, not a full kitchen.
subjects.wall-box: A compact two-shutter kitchen upper WALL BOX, ivory matte laminate faces, visible thin oak side edge, mounted on a tiled wall. Entire cabinet visible, no lower cabinets in frame.
subjects.loft: A continuous row of closed WOOD-GRAIN LOFT SHUTTERS fitted directly below a bedroom ceiling, shallow horizontal overhead storage above wardrobe height, six rectangular shutters across the full row. Frame the loft row only.
subjects.appliance-tower: Indian kitchen vertical appliance tower: a stainless DISHWASHER at the bottom, one slim storage drawer just above it, MICROWAVE in a niche above that, and a closed glossy teal cupboard shutter at the top. Entire tower visible, actual realistic household appliances, not an oven at bottom.
subjects.tall-pantry: Full-height modular kitchen TALL PANTRY unit with its single hinged door open, stainless wire storage baskets attached to the door and a matching upright internal wire-basket rack pulled outward. Teal glossy outer door. Real tall-unit accessory, not ordinary plywood shelves.
subjects.crockery: Full-height dining room CROCKERY cabinet, three clear glass upper doors with warm interior lights, walnut interior shelves holding a few plates and glasses, lower closed drawer and shutter storage. Whole cabinet visible.
subjects.wardrobe: An Indian bedroom WARDROBE with four uninterrupted FULL-LENGTH SHUTTERS from top to bottom, matte warm teak wood-grain laminate. No externally exposed drawers. Four slim simple modern handles. Whole wardrobe visible from a slight angle in a real bedroom.
subjects.cushion-box: A low rectangular BAY WINDOW STORAGE BENCH box with wood-grain hinged front storage and a small concealed locker, photographed under a window. Bare smooth wood top, NO CUSHION, bench-like low proportions.
subjects.cnc-glass: A fitted bedroom SHOWCASE SHUTTER pair made of wooden CNC-cut decorative frames with clear glass inserts, wooden border and delicate geometric CNC patterns, transparent glass behind the cutwork, fitted to a small wall niche. Not a pooja shrine.
subjects.glass-showcase: A fitted bedroom wall SHOWCASE BOX with four framed clear GLASS DOORS, warm oak back panel and shelves visible behind the glass. Whole compact showcase visible against a pale bedroom wall.
subjects.study-table: A practical Indian bedroom STUDY TABLE, wood-grain desk top with softly CURVED corner, knee space, a set of three drawers on one side, clean computer cable provision, no person. Whole desk visible.
subjects.tv-panel: A white polished stone TV BACKGROUND PANEL with subtle grey and gold veining, dark television mounted centrally, focus on the glossy white stone surface. Do not include a bottom storage cabinet.
subjects.tv-box: A long low floating TV BOTTOM BOX UNIT only, white handleless drawer fronts and wood-grain carcass/top edge, mounted on a pale wall, no TV in frame. Whole bottom cabinet visible.
subjects.glass-display: A tall narrow TV SIDE DISPLAY CABINET with glass shelves, clear GLASS SHUTTERS, warm oak wooden back and warm concealed LED shelf lighting. Only one display cabinet, whole unit visible.
subjects.open-display: A tall narrow OPEN DISPLAY BOX with five wooden shelves and warm concealed LED lighting, matte warm wood-grain sides, no glass and no doors. Whole unit visible against a pale wall.
subjects.walk-in-open: An OPEN WALK-IN WARDROBE BOX system with warm oak plywood shelving and open hanging rail bays, NO shutters, no drawers, concealed warm lighting. Medium width about five and a half feet, an orderly real dressing-room storage unit.
subjects.drawer-shelves: A waist-height WALK-IN DRESSING STORAGE unit about five and a half feet wide, with a combination of three wood-grain DRAWERS and open SHELVES, neat rectangular box construction. No mirror and no full-height wardrobe.
subjects.mirror: A full-height DRESSING ROOM MIRROR PANEL, large four-foot-wide seven-foot-high rectangle, slim warm wood border and warm concealed perimeter LED light. Real mirror reflects a subtle neutral bedroom. No vanity cabinet in frame.
subjects.pooja-cnc: A pair of full-height Indian POOJA ROOM WOODEN SHUTTERS with elegant CNC-cut lotus and geometric perforations, three feet overall width and seven feet height, warm teak laminate, subtle golden warm light through cutwork. Doors mostly closed, whole full-height shutter pair visible. No idols, no lettering.
subjects.pooja-drawers: A POOJA ROOM INTERNAL DRAWER BOX, five feet wide and two and a half feet tall, warm teak wood-grain laminate, three neat drawers across the front with another shallow drawer row below, bare wood top, low wide storage. Interior pooja room wall backdrop, no idols or decorative objects. Whole unit visible.
subjects.pantry: A complete PLYWOOD PANTRY STORAGE BOX with plain internal wooden SHELVES and two wood-grain SHUTTERS, one door open to show shelving, three feet wide and seven feet high. NO wire basket pull-outs. Real kitchen pantry cupboard.
subjects.louver: TV-area WOODEN LOUVER PANELING, horizontal rectangular wall panel with finely spaced vertical wood-grain slats and a slim horizontal wooden DISPLAY LEDGE across its top. No TV or storage box. Whole panel visible on a pale wall.
